lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre is criticizing a key feature of the Carney government’s latest budget, arguing the proposed $15-million capital gains exemption on the sale of qualifying shares from a Canadian company applies too narrowly, excluding key businesses, CBC News reports.
For the Canadian Armed Forces veteran and Royal Canadian Legion Branch 101 president, remembering that service is also an opportunity to honour his Métis heritage, The Canadian Press reports.

Nvidia announced Sunday it is launching an independent investigation into its chief executive and founder, Jensen Huang, over concerns he was the “target of a foreign intelligence effort,” The Canadian Press reports.
Pope Leo arrives in Argentina and tells Milei that people, not the economy, should come first, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
